# Gameguru Mania — contemporary review

- Original title: Robin Hood: the Legend of Sherwood
- Source: [Original publication](https://www.ggmania.com/full.php3?show=5494)
- Author / publisher: hx; Gameguru Mania
- Language / date: English; 2002-12-21
- Access: Full compact review and score inspected through indexed text.
- Checked: 2026-09-09

hx rates the game 84%, praising its tactical combat, controls, artificial intelligence, detailed backgrounds, and atmosphere. The review finds strong enemies slow to defeat and notes the lack of multiplayer, alternative modes, and an editor in the reviewed release.

A useful contemporary technical observation is the reviewer’s recommendation to disable three-dimensional surround sound after experiencing stability problems. This is an individual report without a hardware configuration, not proof of the cause. Zoom pixelation is another criticism. The page includes a large screenshot gallery, which was not visually assessed.
